headline: Affine evaluation and LP optimality hold; one bound false as stated; quantile scope unestablished.
evaluation_markdown:
## What is proven
Affine fixed-policy evaluation, normalized flow, compact occupancy polytope, LP optimality, policy extraction, and conditional Slater-point duality.

## What is false as stated
The uniform screen-validity bound fails for small support sets; registered in the false-as-stated register.

## What P4 may rely on
The occupancy-LP pipeline is certifiable; the quantile variant is not.

## Polish
Proofs are complete but notation drift between sections 3 and 5 should be fixed before P5.

method_scores.rationale: Sound core; one false bound; reproducibility proven in P4 round 2.
